name: inflight-artifact
description: Generate and refresh a private 'in-flight work' page (open PRs with CI links, sessions, tasks, what shipped) as a Claude artifact, with sections you shape by prompting

config_dir.title: Config directory
config_dir.description: Where your pages and settings live (pages/<name>.json). Put it in a git checkout or notes vault to keep a history of changes. Created and edited by the inflight-artifact-design skill.

github_user.title: GitHub user
github_user.description: Login whose open and merged PRs to track (also scopes the org search).

repo_roots.title: Local repo roots
repo_roots.description: Comma-separated folders whose child git repos are checked for uncommitted work and drift. Leave empty to skip.

task_backend.title: Task backend
task_backend.description: Where tasks come from. 'none' skips tasks entirely.
